text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I did it! I passed Flower-san and 
took first place!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I've proven beyond a shadow of a doubt 
that I'm growing!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You'll acknowledge me with this too, won't 
you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That I've properly become a model 
Umamusume, a class rep who can run in any 
race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Of course. She has grown tremendously as a 
sprinter over these past three years. With 
this...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
choice_data_list:
Why don't we run in the "Mile 
Championship"?

Do you want to run in the "Mile 
Championship"?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Mm!? Wait a second! If it's the Mile 
Championship, that means...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's 400 meters longer than her 
specialized 1200m distance, but... With 
who she is now, she can definitely win!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It's wonderful!! I am so, very very happy!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
1,600m! What a beautiful ring to it, just 
like the word "Class Rep"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I will definitely live up to your trust, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the next target race was decided: 
the Mile Championship!
